purpose: Caps the width of page content, centres it and keeps the page side margin.

props.name: size
props.description: Content width: sm 384px for sign-in and short forms, md 768px for reading and single-column forms, lg 1024px (default) for wide forms, full 1280px for dashboards

whenToUse: Around the content of every page, so lines stay readable on wide screens
sm for sign-in panels and short forms; md for settings and single-column forms
whenNotToUse: Inside a Card, Modal or Drawer — they already set their own width
To add spacing between elements — use Stack
antiPatterns: Full-width form fields on a wide screen

sizes: Max width `size-container-sm`, `size-container-md`, `size-container-lg` or `size-content-max`, plus side margin `layout-margin-md` on each side

a11yNotes: Purely visual: adds no role or landmark
